    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractPanelElement
    Base of MenuKit's own elements: built once by a builder, immutable after (§0066, applying §0022 to elements).
    AbstractPanelElement.Builder<E,B>
    The builder every MenuKit element's builder extends: the shared vocabulary, in one place, with the same names everywhere.
    Address
    THE keystone of THE ONE WINDOW: one kind-agnostic value that names ANY addressable thing, a vanilla slot, a created slot, a panel element, or a panel itself, so the engine can resolve every behavior by address without ever asking what kind it is.
    AlertDialog
    Builder for a modal acknowledge dialog.
    AlertDialog.Builder
    Builder for an AlertDialog Panel.
    BehaviorKey<V>
    Names ONE behavior the window can resolve, gating, visibility, a panel's opacity, a reaction, and so on.
    BehaviorKeys
    The library's built-in BehaviorKeys, one constant per behaviour.
    Button
    An interactive button within a Panel: a raised background with a centred label, an icon, or a consumer sprite as its whole face.
    Button.Builder
     
    Button.Look
    The look this frame, handed to the render hooks.
    Checkbox
    A boolean setting as a small square with a check mark and a label beside it: the settings-screen convention, and a lens onto the consumer's boolean (§0026, §0066).
    Checkbox.Builder
     
    ChildDispatch
    The one way a list of elements is rendered and receives input (§0066).
    Click
    A mouse click as seen by a PanelElement: which button, plus the modifier keys held at the moment the click was dispatched.
    ClientContainerPanel
    The client half of a ContainerPanel (§0067): what only the client has, declared from the client initializer.
    ClientMenu
    The client half of a CustomMenu (§0067): its screen class, how each of its panels looks, and the request to open it.
    ClientSlots
    The client half of CreatedSlots.onto(AbstractContainerMenu, Player) (§0067): presenting a registered slot group on screen.
    Column
    Build-time vertical layout helper.
    Column.Builder
    Builder for a single column layout.
    ConfirmDialog
    Builder for a modal confirm/cancel dialog.
    ConfirmDialog.Builder
    Builder for a ConfirmDialog Panel.
    ContainerKeys
    The server-tier key whose seam is Containers' own.
    ContainerPanel
    The one-call, no-mixin registration for a panel whose slots have container parity, they appear, click, and sync on every screen that shows the player inventory (survival, creative, and every chest/furnace/modded container), default-on, opt-out per screen.
    ContainerPanel.Builder
    Fluent configuration; terminates in register().
    ControlStyle
    Visual style for INTERACTIVE controls, currently Button and Dropdown/DropdownMulti.
    CreatedSlot
    A vanilla Slot to the outside world.
    CreatedSlots
    Slots real, server-synced, persistent slots onto a vanilla menu, the library half of the §0055 "consumer-composed slot" pattern (IP Pockets, IP Equipment Slots).
    CreatedSlots.Builder
    Fluent configuration for a single slot.
    CreatedSlots.RegisteredSlots
    The result of a slot: the MenuPanel and SlotGroup that were created, plus the flat slot-index range appended to the menu (for consumers that need to walk the registered slots directly).
    CrossAlign
    Cross-axis alignment policy for Row and Column layout helpers.
    CustomAttachmentSpec<O,C>
    Consumer-implemented interface for M7's extension point.
    CustomContainerMenu
    A custom container menu: its created slots, its panels as the server knows them, and whether each is shown (§0067).
    CustomContainerScreen
    Client-side partner to CustomContainerMenu: a standalone screen whose panels hold slot groups.
    CustomContainerScreen.DragMode
    A custom drag behavior for MenuKit slots.
    CustomContainerScreen.KeyAction
    Action triggered by a key press while this screen is open.
    CustomContainerScreen.ScreenEventListener
    Listener for events happening within a MenuKit screen.
    CustomMenu
    The turnkey custom-menu primitive, one define(...).register() chain replaces the ~4 plumbing pieces a consumer used to hand-write for every custom CustomContainerMenu menu (its own MenuType registration, its own open C2S payload + receiver, its own MenuScreens.register, its own open call).
    CustomMenu.Builder
    Fluent configuration; terminates in register().
    CustomMenu.HandlerFactory
    Builds the menu's CustomContainerMenu, handed the menu's own MenuType so the consumer never reaches back to the static handle the define(...).register() chain is still mid-assigning.
    Decl<V>
    A behavior declaration at ONE specificity level (per-slot, per-group, …).
    Decl.Inherit<V>
    Explicit deferral; the cascade falls through to the next level.
    Decl.Set<V>
    An explicit declared value; the cascade stops here.
    Declarations
    Declarations freeze; state does not (§0063).
    Divider
    A line between sections of a panel: a solid fill, no texture, no input.
    Divider.Builder
     
    Dropdown<T>
    A single-selection dropdown: a trigger showing the current choice, and a popover list to pick another from.
    Dropdown.Builder<T>
     
    DropdownMulti<T>
    A multi-selection dropdown: a trigger summarising the chosen set, and a popover list where each row toggles its item.
    DropdownMulti.Builder<T>
     
    DropRule
    Per-attachment death-drop policy for player-scoped slot content (death handling, Phase 1).
    ElementConstants
    The colours and spacings MenuKit's elements share (6.0.0 plan, decision 5).
    ElementHandle
    A typed handle on a panel element (label, button, outline), a created thing that is NOT a slot.
    ElementSpec
    An element whose position a layout helper (Row, Column) computes: its size now, the element itself when ElementSpec.at(int, int) is called with the computed position.
    EphemeralStorage
    In-memory storage that is not persisted.
    Flow
    A run of elements laid out left to right at the panel's runtime width, wrapping onto new rows when it runs out of room: the runtime row.
    Flow.Builder
     
    Focus
    MK-managed focus registration + screen-level focus utilities.
    GatingContext
    The context a SlotGate decision runs in: who is acting.
    GroupKey
    A bulk-addressing group: a stable id plus a membership predicate over Addresses.
    HudIcon
    HUD sprite icon element, renders a texture sprite at configurable size.
    HudNotification
    HUD notification element, a timed popup that slides in, displays for a duration, then fades out.
    HudNotification.Builder
     
    HudNotification.SlideDirection
    Direction the notification slides in from.
    HudPanel
    Builder entry point for HUD panels, visual elements rendered on the game's heads-up display.
    HudPanel.BarBuilder
    Builder for customizing progress bar elements.
    HudPanel.Builder
     
    HudPanel.ItemBuilder
    Builder for customizing item display elements.
    HudPanel.SlotBuilder
    Builder for customizing HUD slot elements.
    HudPanel.TextBuilder
    Builder for customizing text elements.
    HudSlot
    HUD element that renders an item inside a hotbar-style slot background.
    Icon
    A sprite at a fixed size: the "show a picture" primitive.
    Icon.Builder
     
    InfoBox
    A block of text on a raised background: an explanation or a notice inside a panel.
    InfoBox.Builder
     
    InputContext
    Input-time context passed to every PanelElement input method, the input twin of RenderContext (§0066): where the element's containing content origin is on screen, where the mouse is, and whether the element's surroundings are disabled.
    InsideRegion
    A region on a reference rectangle: one of nine spots, the four corners, the four edge midpoints, and the centre, inset from the edge.
    ItemDisplay
    An item drawn at a fixed size, with its count and durability bar, and optionally a coloured outline.
    ItemDisplay.Builder
     
    KeyedStorage
    A Storage that knows its own persistent identity.
    KeyedStorages
    Factories for KeyedStorage, a Storage that declares its own PersistentContainerKey so M1 per-slot metadata persists for registered slots (§0055).
    KindTag
    What KIND of addressable thing an Address names, the one place THE ONE WINDOW distinguishes a slot from an element from a panel.
    MendingCandidates
    The mending primitive's consumer candidate hook, lets a consumer contribute EXTRA items into MKC's unified XP-repair pool, beyond the registered slots opted in by Address via the engine ContainerKeys.MENDING key.
    MendingCandidates.Candidate
    One mendable item plus how to persist its repair.
    MendingCandidates.Provider
    Supplies a player's extra mend candidates when an XP orb is collected.
    MenuPanel
    A panel as a menu knows it on both sides: its id and whether its slots are shown (§0067).
    MenuScreenFactory
    Builds the client CustomContainerScreen for a registered CustomMenu.
    MK
    Mod entry point for MenuKit and the process-wide facade for HUD panels, notifications, and the recipe-book query.
    MKScreen
    Base class for standalone screens built with MenuKit: full-screen, client-local, interactive UIs not tied to a container menu.
    MKTooltip
    The single library entry point for queuing a hover-float tooltip, the one place a Component tooltip becomes pixels on screen.
    MKTooltip.Wheel
    Listener for MKTooltip.onWheel(MKTooltip.Wheel).
    OperationProbe
    The probe a test mod checks the click-tag hand-off and the in-world actions through (§0038, §0068): which operation a sent click carried, and whether an action would be refused.
    OperationProbe.Tag
    A click tag as the probe sees it: the operation pair it carries.
    OutsideRegion
    A region outside a reference rectangle: pick a side, pick which end to align to, and stack away from that end.
    Panel
    The fundamental unit of composition.
    Panel.Builder
    Fluent builder for Panel.
    PanelElement
    A visual or interactive element within a Panel.
    PanelHandle
    A typed handle on a panel itself: its own visibility and opacity.
    PanelPosition
    Where a panel sits: the one placement declaration every host reads (§0065).
    PanelPosition.Mode
    How a panel is positioned.
    PanelStyle
    Visual style for a panel's background rendering.
    PersistentContainerKey
    Persistent identity for a Container, the owner a slot's state attaches to, in a form that survives session boundaries.
    PersistentContainerKey.BlockEntityKey
    Block-entity-backed container (chest, shulker box, furnace, hopper, etc.).
    PersistentContainerKey.EnderChest
    The player's ender chest (distinct from their main inventory).
    PersistentContainerKey.EntityKey
    Entity-backed container (donkey, llama, mule, minecart-with-chest, etc.).
    PersistentContainerKey.Modded
    Modded container type.
    PersistentContainerKey.PlayerInventory
    The player's main inventory, hotbar, armor, and offhand slots.
    PlayerStorage
    Marker interface for Storage implementations that represent the player inventory side of a menu, as opposed to the container side.
    ProgressBar
    A bar filled to a fraction, read every frame: health, progress, a timer.
    ProgressBar.Builder
     
    ProgressBar.Direction
    Which way the fill grows.
    Radio<T>
    One choice of a single-selection set: a square with a dot when its value is the RadioGroup's selection, and a label beside it.
    Radio.Builder<T>
     
    RadioGroup<T>
    The lens a set of Radio buttons shares: which value is selected, read from the consumer every frame and written back when the player picks another (§0026, §0066).
    ReactCause
    Why a reaction fired, an open, identity-tagged descriptor, deliberately not a sealed enum a consumer must switch over (architecture Part 2 §6).
    ReactEvent
    What a ReactiveHook receives when a slot's contents change.
    ReactiveHook
    A consumer's reaction to a slot's synced contents changing on the client, the value type of the ON_INSERT_OBSERVED/ON_TAKE_OBSERVED behavior keys.
    Reference
    The rectangle a panel is placed against, a reference.
    RegionConstants
    Single source of truth for the region-positioning layout constants.
    RenderContext
    Render-time context passed to every PanelElement.render(RenderContext).
    ResolvedSlotGroup
    One slot group as it exists on an open menu: what it is called, what kind of thing it is, and which slots it currently holds.
    Row
    Build-time horizontal layout helper.
    Row.Builder
    Builder for a single row layout.
    ScreenMatcher
    Which screens a registered-slot presence (or any screen-complete feature) applies to, the consumer-facing expression of inventory-screen parity's default-on, opt-out-per-screen rule.
    ScreenOrigin
    Screen-space top-left coordinates of a panel: what a pixel(...) placement supplies each frame, and what a panel host resolves every other placement to (RegionMath.resolveMenu / resolveInside).
    ScreenPanelAdapter
    Puts a Panel on vanilla container screens.
    ScrollContainer
    A clipped viewport over pre-positioned elements, scrolled vertically: the single primitive for "show content larger than its bounds".
    ScrollContainer.Builder
     
    Section
    A collapsible section: a header row that opens and closes the elements under it.
    Section.Builder
     
    Slider<V>
    A slider: vanilla's AbstractSliderButton (§0020), laid out and lensed by MenuKit (§0026, §0066).
    Slider.Builder<V>
     
    SlotElement
    A registered MKC slot presented as a PanelElement, the keystone of the everything-is-a-panel model.
    SlotElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotElement.
    SlotFlowElement
    The reactive slot-wrapping primitive, the slot analogue of element/text reactive sizing (Movement ④).
    SlotFlowElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotFlowElement over slot elements, in flow order.
    SlotGate
    What a slot accepts and releases, and how much of an item it holds: the value of BehaviorKeys.GATING, the slot author's rule.
    SlotGroup
    Where structure lives.
    SlotGroupCategories
    Library-owned registry of per-menu-class SlotGroupResolvers.
    SlotGroupCategory
     
    SlotGroupId
    Names one slot group, one coherent run of slots sitting in one place on screen.
    SlotGroupId.Category
    The one group a resolver contributes for category on a menu: vanilla's resolvers, and a mod's own resolver for its own menu, name a group this way.
    SlotGroupId.Created
    A group created through MenuKit-Containers, named by its declaration.
    SlotGroupPanelAdapter
    Anchors a Panel to a slot group's box on container screens: a toolbar above the player inventory, a readout beside the hotbar.
    SlotGroupResolver
    Per-menu-class strategy that maps an AbstractContainerMenu instance to its SlotGroupCategory-keyed slot groupings, expressed as slot indices (positions in menu.slots).
    SlotGroups
    Every slot group anyone has declared, with no menu open: the menu-free half of the slot group registry.
    SlotGroups.CreatedGroupLookup
    Port (§0062): the created group a live slot belongs to, or null for a slot that is not a created one.
    SlotGroups.Entry
    One row of the player-facing list.
    SlotGroupSet
    A player-facing name for several slot groups that are one thing to the player.
    SlotHandle
    A typed handle on a slot, vanilla or created: the slot verbs, plus the generic WindowHandle.set(BehaviorKey, Decl) substrate.
    SlotLayout
    The slot layout of a CustomContainerMenu: which panels it has, which slot groups each holds, and how shift-click pairs them (§0067).
    SlotLayout.PanelBuilder
    One panel's slot groups and its server-side flags.
    SlotLayout.PanelSlots
    One declared panel, as built: its id, whether it starts shown, whether a player may toggle it, and its slot groups in order.
    SlotNames
    The display-NAME layer for windowed slots, MK-owned, client-side, purely a display concern (separate from identity; see Address).
    SlotOperations
    The slot operations vocabulary: the open set of things that can be done to a slot, what each slot lets through, and the one question every operation asks before it acts.
    SlotOperations.AppliesTo
    Which slot groups an operation can act on.
    SlotOperations.GroupVeto
    A SlotOperations.Veto that is handed the slot's group: SlotGroups.of(SlotRef) of the slot, resolved once per question and shared by every group veto, or null when the slot is in no known group.
    SlotOperations.Role
    What an operation does to the slot it acts on.
    SlotOperations.Veto
    A rule that refuses an operation on a slot, laid over the cascade by a mod that is not the slot's author.
    SlotRef
    The slot an operation is about to act on, as much of it as the seam can supply.
    SlotRendering
    The recessed 18×18 slot frame for registered slots that live outside a vanilla container texture, the one piece of a created slot's presentation that is panel chrome rather than the slot itself.
    SlotScreenRect
    A vanilla slot's on-screen item box in absolute screen-space pixels, what VanillaSlotResolver.resolve(AbstractContainerScreen, int) returns.
    SlotSpec
    A side-neutral, declarative description of one registered-slot group that a ContainerPanel projects onto every container the player opens.
    SlotState
    Public entry point for M1 per-slot persistent state.
    SlotStateChannel<T>
    Typed per-slot state channel, the consumer-facing handle for reading and writing slot state.
    SlotStateChannel.CanWrite
    Who may write this channel from a client (§0067).
    SlotStateChannel.Visibility
    Channel visibility (§0049).
    Storage
    Where items live.
    StorageAttachment<O,C>
    M7, Storage Attachment Taxonomy.
    StorageAttachment.PlayerStorageAttachment<C>
    The death-handling-capable specialization of StorageAttachment, returned only by player-anchored factories (StorageAttachment.playerAttached(String, String, int) and StorageAttachment.customPlayerAttached(CustomAttachmentSpec)).
    StorageContainerAdapter
    Adapts a MenuKit Storage to vanilla's Container interface.
    Tabs
    A tab strip and the area below it that shows the selected tab's body.
    Tabs.Align
    Where tabs sit within a row; in Tabs.Mode.SIDEBAR, where the label sits within its tab.
    Tabs.Builder
     
    Tabs.Mode
    How the strip lays out when the tabs don't fit one row.
    Tabs.Tab
    One tab: an id, a label, a body, and whether it shows.
    Tabs.TabSpec
    A tab under construction.
    Text
    Shared text-rendering helper for MK widgets that render single-line text inside a bounded width.
    TextField
    A single-line text field: vanilla's EditBox (§0020), laid out and lensed by MenuKit (§0026, §0066).
    TextField.Builder
     
    TextLabel
    A line of text in a Panel, fixed or read every frame.
    TextLabel.Builder
     
    Tier
    Which authority tier a BehaviorKey belongs to, the seam where THE ONE WINDOW's client/server split lives.
    Toggle
    A two-state on/off control: MenuKit's general boolean primitive, a lens onto the consumer's boolean and only a lens (§0026, §0066).
    Toggle.Builder
     
    TriBool
    An explicit two-valued boolean for boolean BehaviorKeys, the value a Decl.Set carries, so "explicitly off" is a real declared value distinct from "unset / inherit".
    VanillaScreenPanelAdapter
    Puts a Panel on vanilla non-container screens: Options, Controls, KeyBinds, world select, the title screen, and any other Screen that is not a container screen.
    VanillaSlotResolver
    Resolves a player-inventory slot's on-screen position, slot-agnostic and screen-agnostic.
    VirtualStorage
    The escape hatch.
    VisibilityRule
    The value of the VISIBILITY behavior, whether an addressable thing is shown, as a client-side predicate rather than a static flag.
    Window
    The entry point to THE ONE WINDOW, how a consumer obtains a typed handle to set or read behavior on anything addressable.
    WindowEngine
    The resolution engine of THE ONE WINDOW: one store, one cascade, one method, WindowEngine.resolve(Address, BehaviorKey).
    WindowHandle
    The base of THE ONE WINDOW's typed handle family, an immutable value addressing one thing by its Address, never by a held live reference (the menu and every Slot are recreated each reopen, so a held reference would dangle).
    WindowSignals
    The client-observed slot INTERACTION signals, which slot the cursor is over (WindowSignals.hovered) and which slot was last clicked (WindowSignals.selected), as Addresses.
    WindowView
    The per-session facade of THE ONE WINDOW, bound to the current concrete menu, it mints typed WindowHandles (architecture Part 2 §2).
